You were signed out in Mind. Sign in again to get alerts.
Android rates Dio Alert as rarely used and delays its alerts. Turn off battery optimisation for it and open the app now and then.

The button opens Dio Alert’s settings. Open “Battery usage” and turn on “Allow background activity”; also set Battery → Battery optimisation → Dio Alert to “Don’t optimise”, and in recent apps lock Dio Alert.

Your phone has its own battery settings that apps can’t read. The steps below disappear once an alert arrives on time with the screen off: after changing them, lock the phone and send a test from your Mind profile.
Open recent apps, then tap ⋮ (or long-press) on Dio Alert → Lock.
Adaptive battery is on: it learns to hold back apps you rarely open, and Dio Alert is one. Turn it off in Battery settings.
Turn off “Sleep standby optimisation” (Battery → More settings): it puts the phone to deep sleep at night and delays alerts.
Lock Dio Alert in recent apps (⋮ or long-press its card → Lock), so the system doesn’t close it.
Turn on “Autostart” for Dio Alert in its app settings, so it can wake up for an alert.
Add Dio Alert to “Never sleeping apps” (Battery → Background usage limits).
Sound volume: %1$d%% of the alarm volume
Turn off the alert sound? Real alerts will make no sound, only vibrate and show a notification.
Turn off the alert vibration? Real alerts will not vibrate.
These settings can stop alerts from arriving on time or sounding. This card disappears once they are fixed.
Notifications are off for Dio Alert: alerts won’t show.
These alert kinds are switched off: %1$s.
Background use is restricted for Dio Alert, so alerts may not arrive. Allow background use in the app’s battery settings.
Data Saver blocks Dio Alert in the background, so alerts may not arrive. Allow unrestricted data for it.
Alarm volume is off: alerts play at alarm volume, so they will be silent.
%1$s: with Do Not Disturb on, these alerts won’t show. Turn on “Override Do Not Disturb” for it.
Do Not Disturb is silencing alarms right now, so alerts won’t be heard.
The button opens Dio Alert’s settings. Open “App battery usage”, tap the text “Allow background usage” (not the switch) and choose “Unrestricted”.
The button opens Dio Alert’s settings. Open “Battery” and choose “Unrestricted”.
The button opens Dio Alert’s settings. Open “Battery” → “Battery optimisation”, switch the list at the top to “All apps”, find Dio Alert and choose “Don’t optimise”.
The button opens Dio Alert’s settings. Open “Battery” and choose “Unrestricted”.
The button opens Dio Alert’s settings. Open “Battery saver” and choose “No restrictions”, and turn on “Autostart”.

Unofficial app, not affiliated with any government entity. Alerts are announced by the authorities of Ukraine (official map: https://map.ukrainealarm.com/) and received through the alerts.in.ua API (https://devs.alerts.in.ua/).
